positions.title: Senior Lead, Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for Application Management Services, supporting a legacy and modern claims processing application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on the Hogan Deposits platform. I support the core deposits and online banking interface systems as an engineer and production on-call technician.

Experience and Responsibilities Include:
 ▪ Design, implement, and maintain software in COBOL, with CICS and DB2.
 ▪ Design SOAP-based CICS web services for modernization.
 ▪ Create, maintain, and modify Hogan applications via COBOL and Umbrella.
 ▪ Optimize application performance and manual workflows.
 ▪ Write and revise documentation.
 ▪ Production on-call support for nightly batch and daytime line-of-business support.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Software developer for the state’s payment, personnel, property, and accounting systems. Helped pilot a mainframe modernization project, bridging DB2 and COBOL with a modern Java and JavaScript stack.

Responsibilities included:
 ▪ Work closely with customer and product owner to write requirements and design UI.
 ▪ Design, implement, and maintain software in COBOL with CICS, NATURAL, and JavaScript.
▪ Write RESTful frontend web services in JavaScript with React COBOL.
▪ Write SOAP-based backend web services code in COBOL with CICS.
▪ Implement banking and ACH rules, income tax changes, and credit/debit processing.
 ▪ Research and improve application performance.
 ▪ Write and revise documentation.
 ▪ Research legacy systems for maintenance and modernization.
 
Accomplishments included:
 ▪ Proposed, designed, and implemented a COBOL variable-input payment search engine, providing new functionality and retiring multiple legacy workflows for the users.
 ▪ Organized and converted 70 million payment transactions across 3 tables to 2, providing more detail and improved data structure, and tripled table query performance in multiple mainframe programs.
 ▪ Modernized mainframe batch and CICS applications using SOAP and REST API-based web applications, on mainframe and on modern stack.
 ▪ Transitioned waterfall requirements and development practices to agile.
 ▪ Business, technology, and design contributor to new software stack and standards for legacy system modernization.
 ▪ Standardized the testing documentation for the dev and QA teams.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Assistant teacher in English and group tutor in math at local Austin middle and high schools. Responsibilities include tutoring students, teaching smaller groups within classrooms, planning lessons, documenting academic progress, and assessing students' needs.

positions.title: Student Supervisor
positions.description: Managed general staff, planned weekly operations, interviewed applicants, ordered and received merchandise.
